body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-14 23:54Z, learned from my own wrong advice). A credited test command must not contain any argument naming a path outside the measured (named) worktree: not `--target-dir <sibling or shared dir>`, not `--manifest-path ../..`, and so on. The running host (cec32aee and later) refuses credit for such commands under engram_check_paths.rs::engram_check_worktree_in, which allows only --engram-binary to point outside. Before w-c538 lands, the refusal is SILENT: no Test record and no notice. Proof D's R_d run test-1956535a (Sol-a7bb) lost its credit this way. For warm builds, use the root's own target (the default, or `--target-dir target`). Accept a cold build in a no-gate slot rather than an outside path, and never use env-var or symlink tricks to hide the path.
